title: Personal Pronouns and Basic Sentence Structure
module: Módulo 1 — Primeiras estruturas e frases essenciais
main_grammar: pronomes pessoais do sujeito e ordem sujeito + verbo + complemento.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Who you are and two people you know” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Brazilian Portuguese usually follows subject + verb + complement.
student.english_comparison: English also uses subject–verb–complement; Portuguese verbs change with the subject.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I am a student.”?
Which sentence expresses “You are a teacher.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Eu sou Ana. Eu sou aluna. Você é Pedro. Você é aluno. Ela é Lara. Ela é professora. Ele é Paulo. Ele é professor. Nós somos amigos. Vocês são alunos.

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Notice who does or is something before choosing the verb.
review.compare: Eu sou aluno / Ela é professora: the pronoun determines the form.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Eu sou Maria e ele é Leo. Eu sou aluna e ele é aluno. Ela é professora. Nós somos amigos. Vocês são alunos? Sim, vocês são alunos. Eu sou brasileira e ele é americano.

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I am a student.”? A. Eu sou aluno. B. Ele é americano. C. Você é professor.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: A. Eu sou aluno. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.worked_answer: Eu → Eu sou aluno. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela é brasileira. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I am a student. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ana é aluna. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Ele é americano.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Nós somos amigos. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Vocês são alunos. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “You are a teacher.”?

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Eu sou Julia. Você é Daniel. Nós somos amigos. Ela é professora e ele é aluno. Vocês são alunos também. Eu sou brasileira. Ele é americano. Ela é brasileira. Nós somos pessoas diferentes e somos amigos.
questions: No texto, ela é professora ou aluna?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 4–6 sentences on the topic “Who you are and two people you know”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Você é aluno? / Ela é professora? / Vocês são amigos? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Stress the last syllable of você and the first of somos.

mini_reading.translation: I am Ana. I am a student. You are Pedro. You are a student. She is Lara. She is a teacher. He is Paulo. He is a teacher. We are friends. You are students.

fill_in.full_sentence: Ele é americano. Ela é brasileira.
Nós somos amigos. Ele é americano.
Vocês são alunos. Nós somos amigos.
Eu sou aluno. Vocês são alunos.

reading_aloud.translation: I am Maria and he is Leo. I am a student and he is a student. She is a teacher. We are friends. Are you all students? Yes, you are students. I am Brazilian and he is American.

speaking_practice.question: Você é aluno?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu é aluno. → Eu sou aluno. (Eu requires sou.) Ela sou professora. → Ela é professora. (Ela requires é.)

speaking_practice.question: Ela é professora?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu é aluno. → Eu sou aluno. (Eu requires sou.) Ela sou professora. → Ela é professora. (Ela requires é.)

speaking_practice.question: Vocês são amigos?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu é aluno. → Eu sou aluno. (Eu requires sou.) Ela sou professora. → Ela é professora. (Ela requires é.)

E_reading.translation: I am Julia. You are Daniel. We are friends. She is a teacher and he is a student. You are students too. I am Brazilian. He is American. She is Brazilian. We are different people and we are friends.

answers.question: Julia e Daniel são amigos?
answers.answer: Sim, Julia e Daniel são amigos.

answers.question: No texto, ela é professora ou aluna?

F_written_production.model_text: Eu sou Julia. Você é Daniel. Nós somos amigos. Ela é professora e ele é aluno. Vocês são alunos também. Eu sou brasileira. Ele é americano. Ela é brasileira. Nós somos pessoas diferentes e somos amigos.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
